answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, whose transition mass is constrained by conductance. A Sybil cluster with few links to honest nodes forms a sparse external cut; low conductance limits its escape probability and, through min-cut transitivity bounds, caps its aggregate voting weight despite internal collusion. Thus an identity labeled meadow, jetty, or comet cannot amplify influence without costly, credible attestations.
